What defines this territory?

Society service areas, the 1997/98 map, later 2001 descriptions and modern statistical geography are different evidence. Keep their dates and purposes separate.

Registration, source dates and uncertainty

Three physical control points per main-map page support a preliminary affine fit in BC Albers. They provide no independent registration accuracy. Comparisons retain the full source footprint without clipping it to modern land; marine jurisdiction is unresolved. The selected modern edges were not used to fit the maps or extract the council traces.

Southern insets and the separate twenty-region statistical map are not registered. Coarse metropolitan source detail limits the Vancouver/Richmond comparison. Current municipalities and school districts may differ from their historical versions. Individual-feature screening is distinct from comparing a whole modern LHA combination. The working Vancouver/Richmond trace applies a provisional 5 km northward local display adjustment. Other slider positions are sensitivity scenarios; the original global registration controls remain unchanged.

Original Ministry of Health cartography: BC Auditor General, March 1998. Current BC data retain the Open Government Licence – British Columbia. Data and results are embedded in this file; it works offline. No historical legal boundary is verified.
